comment_regular: Compute Oblivion's precomputed skill-use requirement: pow(baseSkillValue * g_fSkillUseFactor, g_fSkillUseExp), multiplied by g_fSkillUseSpecMult only for a class-specialization match, then by g_fSkillUseMajorMult for a strict major match or g_fSkillUseMinorMult for every fallback/non-major skill. With native defaults the factors are 0.5625 (major+specialized), 0.75 (major), 0.9375 (non-major+specialized), and 1.25 (non-major).
